component.name: SaverScene

Label.text: Pick a scene for your TV

component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundColor = "0x000000FF" m.top.backgroundUri = "" m.vid = m.top.findNode("vid") m.vid.loop = true m.vid.mute = true ' Keep the Roku's own screensaver from starting on top of us m.vid.disableScreenSaver = true m.top.setFocus(true) m.vid.observeField("state", "onState")
m.box = m.top.findNode("box") m.clock = m.top.findNode("clock") m.clock.font = makeFont(84) m.weatherLabel = m.top.findNode("weather") m.weatherLabel.font = makeFont(44) m.msg = m.top.findNode("msg") m.msg.font = makeFont(32) m.setup = m.top.findNode("setup") m.top.findNode("setupTitle").font = makeFont(64) m.setupText = m.top.findNode("setupText") m.setupText.font = makeFont(40)
m.now = CreateObject("roDateTime") m.tick = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.tick.duration = 5 m.tick.repeat = true m.tick.observeField("fire", "updateClock") m.tick.control = "start"
m.current = "" m.fetch = CreateObject("roSGNode", "FetchTask") m.fetch.observeField("video", "onVideo") m.fetch.observeField("weather", "onOverlay") m.fetch.observeField("clock", "onOverlay") m.fetch.observeField("error", "onError") m.fetch.observeField("sound", "onSound") m.fetch.observeField("setup", "onSetup") m.fetch.observeField("status", "onStatus") m.fetch.observeField("popupUrl", "onPopup") m.fetch.observeField("popupTitle", "onPopup") m.fetch.observeField("message", "onBanner") m.statusGroup = m.top.findNode("statusGroup") m.statusLabels = [] m.popup = m.top.findNode("popup") m.top.findNode("popupTitle").font = makeFont(40) m.banner = m.top.findNode("banner") m.bannerText = m.top.findNode("bannerText") m.bannerText.font = makeFont(52) m.fetch.control = "run" onOverlay() end sub
sub diag(msg as string) if m.server = invalid cfg = ParseJson(ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/config.json")) m.server = cfg.server end if t = CreateObject("roSGNode", "LogTask") t.server = m.server t.msg = msg t.control = "run" if m.logs = invalid then m.logs = [] m.logs.push(t) end sub
function makeFont(size as integer) as object f = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Font") f.uri = "font:SystemFontFile" f.size = size return f end function
sub onVideo() url = m.fetch.video if url = m.current or url = "" then return m.current = url content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url content.streamFormat = "mp4" m.vid.control = "stop" m.vid.content = content m.vid.control = "play" m.top.setFocus(true) ' keep remote presses coming to the scene, not the player end sub
sub onOverlay() showClock = m.fetch.clock m.clock.visible = showClock m.weatherLabel.text = m.fetch.weather m.box.visible = showClock or m.fetch.weather <> "" or (m.statusLabels <> invalid and m.statusLabels.Count() > 0) updateClock() end sub
' Right-align the clock and weather at the same edge and wrap the box snugly around them. sub fitBox() right = 1860 pad = 32 widest = 0 y = 40 if m.clock.visible w = m.clock.boundingRect().width m.clock.translation = [right - pad - w, y] widest = w y = 130 end if if m.weatherLabel.text <> "" w = m.weatherLabel.boundingRect().width m.weatherLabel.translation = [right - pad - w, y] if w > widest then widest = w y = y + 70 else y = y + 10 end if if m.statusLabels <> invalid for each l in m.statusLabels w = l.boundingRect().width l.translation = [right - pad - w, y] if w > widest then widest = w y = y + 52 end for end if m.box.width = widest + pad * 2 m.box.height = y - 25 + 20 m.box.translation = [right - m.box.width, 25] end sub
sub onSetup() url = m.fetch.setup m.setup.visible = (url <> "") if url <> "" m.top.findNode("qr").uri = url + "/qr.png?text=" + url m.setupText.text = "Scan with your phone, or open " + url end if end sub
' Status lines from Home Assistant, e.g. "Front door: Unlocked" (alerts in amber). sub onStatus() items = ParseJson(m.fetch.status) if items = invalid then items = [] m.statusGroup.removeChildrenIndex(m.statusGroup.getChildCount(), 0) m.statusLabels = [] for each it in items l = m.statusGroup.createChild("Label") l.font = makeFont(38) l.text = it.text if it.alert = true l.color = "0xFFC24DFF" else l.color = "0xFFFFFFDD" end if m.statusLabels.push(l) end for onOverlay() end sub
' Camera picture (or any picture) pushed by Home Assistant for a little while. sub onPopup() url = m.fetch.popupUrl m.popup.visible = (url <> "") if url <> "" m.top.findNode("popupImg").uri = url m.top.findNode("popupTitle").text = m.fetch.popupTitle end if end sub
sub onBanner() text = m.fetch.message m.banner.visible = (text <> "") if text <> "" m.bannerText.text = text w = m.bannerText.boundingRect().width bg = m.top.findNode("bannerBg") bg.width = w + 80 bg.translation = [(1920 - w - 80) / 2, 920] m.bannerText.translation = [(1920 - w) / 2, 940] end if end sub
sub onSound() m.vid.mute = not m.fetch.sound end sub
' Like a screensaver: any button closes it (the press isn't passed on). function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press m.vid.control = "stop" m.top.done = true end if return true end function
sub onError() m.msg.text = m.fetch.error end sub
sub updateClock() m.now.Mark() m.now.ToLocalTime() h = m.now.GetHours() ampm = "AM" if h >= 12 then ampm = "PM" h = h mod 12 if h = 0 then h = 12 mins = m.now.GetMinutes() mm = mins.ToStr() if mins < 10 then mm = "0" + mm m.clock.text = h.ToStr() + ":" + mm + " " + ampm fitBox() end sub
' If the server hiccups, try again in a few seconds instead of sitting black. sub onState() if m.vid.state = "error" diag("video error: " + m.vid.errorMsg + " (code " + m.vid.errorCode.ToStr() + ") for " + m.current) end if if m.vid.state = "error" or m.vid.state = "finished" m.retry = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.retry.duration = 5 m.retry.observeField("fire", "replay") m.retry.control = "start" end if end sub
sub replay() m.vid.control = "stop" m.vid.control = "play" end sub
